propositions: Extract the except-arm handling logic from run() into a standalone interpret_failure() function taking explicit parameters (exc, run_messages, req_limit, eff_max_iter).
The three except arms must preserve order: UsageLimitExceeded, then LLMError, then broad Exception.
Within the broad arm, translate_sampling_parameter_rejection must run first, reclassifying sampling-parameter rejections to a typed config error rather than LLMUnavailableError.
translate_sampling_parameter_rejection only inspects and reclassifies; it performs no retry and preserves the resolve-then-execute shape.
The raised exception type must stay unchanged for each arm so existing callers still work, with classified disposition attached as metadata only.
Any moved monkeypatch targets must be repointed in the same commit and documented with reasons.
